caption_L1: Total expenditure in grocery stores in Great Britain in 1st quarter 2015 to 1st quarter 2017 , by grocer (in million GBP) is a bar diagram. Grocers is measured along the y-axis. There is a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 8,000 on the x-axis, marked 12 weeks to March 29, 2015.
caption_L2L3: In the 12 weeks to 29 March 2015 Tesco had the most expenditure at approximately £7,000 (million GBP), and Iceland had the least. Sainsburys and Asda had a very similar expenditure. No grocery store had zero expenditure as would be expected and Iceland, Lidl and Other stores all performed at the lower end of the expenditure scale.
